t: Refactoring Hell: Forging a Transparent AI Tool System
s: This journal entry details the iterative process of debugging an AI system after a refactoring effort, highlighting the need for system transparency and robust logging. It introduces dynamic tool discovery and new commands for AI memory management.
sub: Dynamic AI tool discovery replacing manual registration
Debugging NameError from refactoring AI modules
Implementing 'note' and 'notes' commands for AI Keychain (persistent memory)
Enhancing system transparency through logging and discoverable tools
